title: LeanForth replay report, schema version 0.1
description: The answer of replaying a run record (src/import/run-replay.fs): confirmed when a new run of the same input wrote a record equal to it in every field, refused otherwise, with one finding per difference: a code and the JSON path of the field. Documented in docs/programming/RUN_RECORDS.md.
$comment: Uses only the keywords that tests/support/schema_subset.py implements; it refuses any other keyword. Patterns are ECMA-262 regular expressions for the u flag.

findings.description: The first 32 findings, in the order the comparison met them.

path.description: A JSON path from $: member names after dots, array indices in brackets; a name taken from the old record may be cut at 128 bytes.
